with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

      select collection.id from public.collections collection

    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.

      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered
select collect_member_actions.history_page(p_collection_id,p_query,p_sort,p_cursor,p_limit);

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with readable as materialized (
    select collection.id from public.collections collection
    where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, actor)
  ), scoped as (
    select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
      payment.posted_at,
      coalesce(payment.contributor_user_id = actor, false) as own,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        then payment.transaction_id end as transaction_id,
      case when payment.contributor_user_id = actor then 'You'
        when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
          and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end as supporter_label,
      collection.title,
      payment.collection_id in (select id from readable) as can_read_collection
    from public.payments payment
    join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
    where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
      and (p_collection_id is null or payment.collection_id = p_collection_id)
      and (payment.contributor_user_id = actor
        or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
  ), matched as (
    select * from scoped
    where query_text = ''
      or strpos(lower(supporter_label), query_text) > 0
      or strpos(lower(coalesce(transaction_id, '')), query_text) > 0
      or (can_read_collection and strpos(lower(title), query_text) > 0)
  )
  select collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(count(*)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf), 0)),
    collect_member_actions.exact_json_amount(coalesce(sum(amount_rwf) filter (where own), 0)),
    coalesce(to_jsonb(array_agg(distinct collection_id::text
      order by collection_id::text) filter (where own)), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- A 256-bit XOR of per-row SHA-256 digests has constant aggregate space.
    -- Row identity is included, so a changed/missing row changes the revision
    -- with overwhelming probability; count also distinguishes cardinality.
    md5(row(actor, p_collection_id, query_text, p_sort, count(*),
      coalesce(bit_xor(('x' || encode(extensions.digest(
        row(id, collection_id, amount_rwf, posted_at, own,
          transaction_id, supporter_label)::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'))::bit(256)),
        repeat('0', 256)::bit(256)))::text)
                                                                             from matched

with readable as materialized (
      select collection.id from public.collections collection
      where public.user_can_read_collection(collection.id, $1)
    ), candidate as (
      select payment.id, payment.collection_id, payment.amount_rwf,
        payment.posted_at, payment.contributor_user_id, payment.transaction_id,
        payment.anonymity_choice, payment.contributor_public_id
      from public.payments payment
      join public.collections collection on collection.id = payment.collection_id
      where payment.status = 'posted' and payment.currency = 'RWF'
        and ($2::uuid is null or payment.collection_id = $2)
        and (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
          or payment.collection_id in (select id from readable))
        and ($3 = ''
          or strpos(lower(case when payment.contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
            when payment.anonymity_choice = 'public_id'
              and payment.contributor_public_id is not null
              then 'Collect ID ' || payment.contributor_public_id
            else 'Anonymous supporter' end), $3) > 0
          or (payment.contributor_user_id = $1
            and strpos(lower(coalesce(payment.transaction_id, '')), $3) > 0)
          or (payment.collection_id in (select id from readable)
            and strpos(lower(collection.title), $3) > 0))
        and ($4::uuid is null or payment.amount_rwf > $6 or (payment.amount_rwf = $6 and (payment.posted_at < $5 or (payment.posted_at = $5 and payment.id > $4))))
      order by payment.amount_rwf, payment.posted_at desc, payment.id
      limit $7 + 1
    ), numbered as (
      select candidate.*, row_number() over (order by amount_rwf, posted_at desc, id) as position
      from candidate
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_id', 'momo:' || id,
      'collection_id', collection_id,
      'amount_minor', amount_rwf,
      'currency', 'RWF',
      'rail', 'rwanda_momo',
      'posted_at', posted_at,
      'transaction_id', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then transaction_id end,
      'is_current_user_contribution', coalesce(contributor_user_id = $1, false),
      'supporter_label', case when contributor_user_id = $1 then 'You'
        when anonymity_choice = 'public_id' and contributor_public_id is not null
          then 'Collect ID ' || contributor_public_id
        else 'Anonymous supporter' end
    ) order by position) filter (where position <= $7), '[]'::jsonb),
    count(*) > $7,
    max(case when position = $7 then 'momo:' || id end)
    from numbered

with page as materialized (
    select event.id, event.type, event.status, event.created_at,
      profile.public_id
    from public.notification_events event
    join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
    where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
      and (
        p_search is null
        or event.type ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
        or profile.public_id = p_search
      )
    order by
      case when coalesce(p_sort, 'created_at_desc') = 'created_at_asc'
        then event.created_at end asc nulls last,
      event.created_at desc,
      event.id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ), enriched as (
    select page.*,
      delivery_counts.delivery_count,
      delivery_counts.failed_count
    from page
    left join lateral (
      select count(*)::bigint as delivery_count,
        count(*) filter (where delivery.status = 'failed')::bigint
          as failed_count
      from public.notification_deliveries delivery
      where delivery.event_id = page.id
    ) delivery_counts on true
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        public._admin_row(
          row.id,
          replace(initcap(replace(row.type, '_', ' ')), 'Momo', 'MoMo'),
          'Collect ID ' || row.public_id || ' • ' ||
            row.delivery_count || ' deliveries',
          row.status,
          case when row.failed_count > 0
            then row.failed_count || ' failed' else '' end,
          row.created_at,
          jsonb_build_object('failed_deliveries', row.failed_count)
        )
        order by
          case when coalesce(p_sort, 'created_at_desc') = 'created_at_asc'
            then row.created_at end asc nulls last,
          row.created_at desc,
          row.id
      )
      from enriched row
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', (
      select count(*)
      from public.notification_events event
      join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
      where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
        and (

with page as materialized (
    select event.id, event.type, event.status, event.created_at,
      profile.public_id
    from public.notification_events event
    join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
    where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
      and (
        p_search is null
        or event.type ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
        or profile.public_id = p_search
      )
    order by
      case when coalesce(p_sort, 'created_at_desc') = 'created_at_asc'
        then event.created_at end asc nulls last,
      event.created_at desc,
      event.id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ), enriched as (
    select page.*,
      delivery_counts.delivery_count,
      delivery_counts.failed_count
    from page
    left join lateral (
      select count(*)::bigint as delivery_count,
        count(*) filter (where delivery.status = 'failed')::bigint
          as failed_count
      from public.notification_deliveries delivery
      where delivery.event_id = page.id
    ) delivery_counts on true
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        public._admin_row(
          row.id,
          replace(initcap(replace(row.type, '_', ' ')), 'Momo', 'MoMo'),
          'Collect ID ' || row.public_id || ' • ' ||
            row.delivery_count || ' deliveries',
          row.status,
          case when row.failed_count > 0
            then row.failed_count || ' failed' else '' end,
          row.created_at,
          jsonb_build_object('failed_deliveries', row.failed_count)
        )
        order by
          case when coalesce(p_sort, 'created_at_desc') = 'created_at_asc'
            then row.created_at end asc nulls last,
          row.created_at desc,
          row.id
      )
      from enriched row
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', (
      select count(*)
      from public.notification_events event
      join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
      where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
        and (
          p_search is null
          or event.type ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
          or profile.public_id = p_search
        )
    )
  )

with page as materialized (
    select event.id, event.type, event.status, event.created_at,
      profile.public_id
    from public.notification_events event
    join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
    where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
      and (
        p_search is null
        or event.type ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
        or profile.public_id = p_search
      )
    order by
      case when coalesce(p_sort, 'created_at_desc') = 'created_at_asc'
        then event.created_at end asc nulls last,
      event.created_at desc,
      event.id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ), enriched as (
    select page.*,
      delivery_counts.delivery_count,
      delivery_counts.failed_count
    from page
    left join lateral (
      select count(*)::bigint as delivery_count,
        count(*) filter (where delivery.status = 'failed')::bigint
          as failed_count
      from public.notification_deliveries delivery
      where delivery.event_id = page.id
    ) delivery_counts on true
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        public._admin_row(
          row.id,
          replace(initcap(replace(row.type, '_', ' ')), 'Momo', 'MoMo'),
          'Collect ID ' || row.public_id || ' • ' ||
            row.delivery_count || ' deliveries',
          row.status,
          case when row.failed_count > 0
            then row.failed_count || ' failed' else '' end,
          row.created_at,
          jsonb_build_object('failed_deliveries', row.failed_count)
        )
        order by
          case when coalesce(p_sort, 'created_at_desc') = 'created_at_asc'
            then row.created_at end asc nulls last,
          row.created_at desc,
          row.id
      )
      from enriched row
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', (
      select count(*)
      from public.notification_events event
      join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
      where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
        and (
          p_search is null
          or event.type ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
          or profile.public_id = p_search
        )
    )
  )

    ), '[]'::jsonb),

      select count(*)
      from public.notification_events event
      join public.profiles profile on profile.id = event.user_id
      where (p_status is null or event.status = p_status)
        and (
          p_search is null
          or event.type ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
          or profile.public_id = p_search
        )
    )
  )
